programme.title: Travel Waes: De Bucketlist / Reizen Waes: de bucketlist
programme.desc: Tom makes a journey through the Appalachen, a forgotten and abandoned corner of the US. A mountain range and a region of the same name that, among other things, runs through the States Tennessee, Kentucky, North-Carolina and West-Virginia. In the Appalachen, Tom gets to know a lot of strange Americans who live far away from the big American cities. Each of them leads their own life in one of the most remote areas of America. / Tom maakt een reis doorheen de Appalachen, een vergeten en verlaten uithoek van de VS. Een gebergte en een gelijknamige regio die ondermeer door de staten Tennessee, Kentucky, North-Carolina en West-Virginia loopt. In de Appalachen leert Tom heel wat zonderlinge Amerikanen kennen die ver weg van de grote Amerikaanse steden leven. Elk van hen leidt een heel eigen leven in een van de meest afgelegen gebieden van Amerika.

programme.title: Flanders Holiday Country / Vlaanderen vakantieland
programme.desc: Maureen Vanherberghen and actor Titus De Voogdt dive in the war and mining past of Limburg (and you can take the latter very literally). Maureen and Titus visit the brand new and hip war museum Liberation Garden in Leopoldsburg, where they are familiar with by curator Peter Schrijvers. The museum tells the history of Garnizensstad Leopoldsburg and the role of the region in the Second World War in an interactive way. In the evening they spend the night in Bandb Olit in Paal. After a hearty breakfast, Maureen and Titus go to Be-Mine, the old mining site of Beringen. There they will dive between the tropical freshwater fish of Snorkel and Dive Center Todi in the old coal laundry of the mine. As icing on the cake they get an initiation helmet diving. / Maureen Vanherberghen en acteur Titus De Voogdt duiken in het oorlogs- en het mijnverleden van Limburg (en dat laatste mag je heel letterlijk nemen). Maureen en Titus bezoeken het gloednieuwe en hippe oorlogsmuseum Liberation Garden in Leopoldsburg, waar ze wegwijs gemaakt worden door curator Peter Schrijvers. Het museum vertelt op een interactieve manier de geschiedenis van garnizoensstad Leopoldsburg en de rol van de streek in de Tweede Wereldoorlog. s Avonds overnachten ze in BandB OLit in Paal. Na een stevig ontbijt trekken Maureen en Titus naar be-MINE, de oude mijnsite van Beringen. Daar gaan ze duiken tussen de tropische zoetwatervissen van snorkel- en duikcentrum TODI in de oude kolenwasserij van de mijn. Als kers op de taart krijgen ze een initiatie helmduiken.

A mountain range and a region of the same name that, among other things, runs through the States Tennessee, Kentucky, North-Carolina and West-Virginia. In the Appalachen, Tom gets to know a lot of strange Americans who live far away from the big American cities. Each of them leads their own life in one of the most remote areas of America. / Tom maakt een reis doorheen de Appalachen, een vergeten en verlaten uithoek van de VS. Een gebergte en een gelijknamige regio die ondermeer door de staten Tennessee, Kentucky, North-Carolina en West-Virginia loopt. In de Appalachen leert Tom heel wat zonderlinge Amerikanen kennen die ver weg van de grote Amerikaanse steden leven. Elk van hen leidt een heel eigen leven in een van de meest afgelegen gebieden van Amerika.

programme.title: The Council of Soekie / De Raad van Soekie
programme.desc: Soekie's big dream comes true: her great idol, the prime minister, comes to visit the school. Soekie can give her a tour of the school. But Soekie is so starstruck that she only starts to sweat very hard when seeing the prime minister and does not come out of her words. She fears that she will go off before the minister's eyes. / De grote droom van Soekie komt uit: haar grote idool, de eerste minister, komt de school bezoeken. Soekie mag haar een rondleiding geven door de school. Maar Soekie is zo starstruck dat ze alleen nog maar bij het zien naar de eerste minister, heel hard begint te zweten en niet uit haar woorden komt. Ze vreest dat ze zal afgaan voor de ogen van de minister.

programme.title: The Hoppers / De Hoppers
programme.desc: Arno is a bit in the pit because he has never had a love and has never kissed. He is in love with Olivia, but he has never dared to say this. Geert encourages Arno to express his feelings to Olivia. Arno puts on his bad shoes and tries to conquer Olivias Hart. Everyone is surprised when that suddenly seems to work. / Arno zit wat in de put omdat hij nog nooit een lief heeft gehad en nog nooit heeft gekust. Hij is verliefd op Olivia, maar hij heeft dit nog nooit durven zeggen. Geert moedigt Arno aan om zijn gevoelens te uiten aan Olivia. programme.title: Aloa face the forehead / Alo Alo
programme.desc: One of the most popular British comedies in the 1980s, located in the World War II in France occupied by German troops. In the town of Nouvion, Rene runs the Cafe Artois, a place to socialize French, and the Germans. Colonel von Strohm asks Renea to hide in his cafe stolen the image, which he wanted himself at the same time as Hitler. U gradiću Nouvion, Rene vodi kafić Artois, mjesto za druženje Francuza, a i Nijemaca. Pukovnik Von Strohm traži od Renea da sakrije u svom kafiću ukradenu sliku, koju je istodobno poželio i sam Hitler. Rene pokušava održati ravnotežu u svom poslu kako bi udovoljio francuskom Otporu i nacističkim trupama i tako mogao preživjeti.

programme.title: On the edge of the terrain / Na ivici terena
programme.desc: The emission "on the edge of the field" reveals you how our famous athletes live, far from homeland, and how to defend the colors of the biggest clubs. As their lives in trainings and in the field where the heart is left, tears and sweat and how they spend their free time when they do not win points and titles. Our sports lovers will also give you short postcards, and discover something about the history of clubs in which our athletes dizzically conquer not only points in important competitions and derbies, but also the hearts of the fans. You will meet some of the famous Serbian athletes who have already enrolled in the history of great European clubs. / Emisija "Na ivici terena" otkriće vam kako žive naši poznati sportisti, daleko od domovine, i kako brane boje najvećih klubova. Kako to izgleda njihov život na treninzima i na terenu na kojem se ostavlja srce, suze i znoj i kako provode slobodno vrijeme kada ne osvajaju poene i titule. Naši zaljubljenici u sport prirediće vam i kratke razglednice gradova, te vam otkriti ponešto o istoriji klubova u kojima naši sportisti vrtoglavo osvajaju ne samo bodove na važnim takmičenjima i derbijima, nego i srca navijača. Upoznaćete neke od slavnih srpskih sportista koji su se već upisali u istoriju velikih evropskih klubova.

Milomir Marić spaja nespojivo, na granici gdje prestaju politička propaganda i lažna obećanja, a počinje stvarnost. Političari govore kao obični ljudi, bez cenzure i političkih floskula.

programme.title: From morning to tomorrow / Od jutra do sutra
programme.desc: The series follows the life behind and in front of the camera of your favorite TV steam, Roe deer and Mark. The two of them except the couple are in the studio, they are for years and private life. However, what the audience doesn't even want, is that their idyll on the screen has nothing to do with what the cameras turn off - the two of them actually live a nightmare. When the Marko director of Television is quitting, to move to competing television, he gets a blow from which he falls into a coma, and the director finds a double, young actor Damjan. Damjan will have to play an Oscar brand, and will it work? In addition to being in an interesting way, with many laughs and life situations, their relationship and relationships with colleagues and friends, even to the vortex of the media, will see many secrets, and those business and new love and friendship, and start new avalanches of rivalry. / Serija prati život iza i ispred kamera omiljenog TV para, Srne i Marka. Njih dvoje osim što su par u studiju, oni su to godinama i privatnom životu. Međutim, ono što publika ni ne sluti, jeste da njihova idila na ekranu nema nikakve veze sa onom kad se kamere ugase – njih dvoje zapravo žive noćnu moru. Kada Marko direktoru televizije zatraži otkaz, kako bi prešao na konkurentsku televiziju, dobija udarac od kojeg pada u komu, a direktor pronalazi dvojnika, mladog glumca Damjana. Damjan će morati da odigra Marka za Oskara, a da li će to i uspjeti? Osim što će se na zanimljiv način, sa mnogo smijeha i životnih situacija, usložnjavati njihov odnos i odnos sa kolegama i prijateljima, pa i suparnicima, kroz vrtlog užurbanog života medija, na vidjelo će izaći mnoge tajne, i one poslovne i one privatne, i roditi se neke nove ljubavi i prijateljstva, i pokrenuti nove lavine suparništva.

programme.title: A nation witness / Narod priča
programme.desc: The new format, the author's travel-recorted journalist Biljana Stokic, discovery what the heart of the people tells about the Serbian, the tradition and history of our cities and villages, their everyday life and the struggle for preserving true values, diligent work, faith, and love for theirs and ours, Otamb. In a combination of sincere stories of those who live on their work, through the discovery of the sights and natural beauties of our country and their homes, with the words of hope and inspiration, and with pictures of which the heart is melted, with a cheerfulness that defeats all obstacles and problems, Biljana Stokic will peek into their everyday life. How does an ordinary man live? What are his problems and challenges? What is the strength to work and nurture tradition and good interpersonal relationships? How does our native lump breathe and does she have a flat in her beauty? What do they remember? What are they stunned before? What are they coming back? In front of our camera, they will open up and tell the story, who we do not know how much they carry love, research, courage in themselves, those who know how strangely difficult and easy life is, those who have felt the suffering and beauty of life's simplicity. / Novi format, autorska putopisno-reportažna emisija novinarke Biljane Stokić, otkriće vam šta srce naroda priča o Srpskoj, o tradiciji i istoriji naših gradova i sela, o njihovoj svakodnevici i borbi za očuvanje pravih vrijednosti, marljivom radu, vjeri, i ljubavi prema njihovoj i našoj, otadžbini. U spletu iskrenih priča onih koji žive od svog rada, kroz otkrivanje znamenitosti i prirodnih ljepota naše zemlje i njihovih domova, uz riječi nade i inspiracije, te uz slike od kojih se rastopi srce, sa vedrinom koja porazi sve prepreke i probleme, Biljana Stokić će, dugogodišnjim novinarskim iskustvom, zaviriti u njihovu svakodnevicu. Kako živi običan čovjek? Koji su njegovi problemi i izazovi? U čemu nalazi snagu za radom i njegovanje tradicije i dobrih međuljudskih odnosa? Kako diše naša rodna gruda i ima li joj u ljepoti ravne? Čega se sjećaju? Pred čim ostaju zadivljeni? Čemu se vraćaju? Pred našom kamerom, otvoriće se i ispričati priču, oni za koje ne znamo koliko u sebi nose ljubavi, istrajnosti, hrabrosti, oni koji znaju koliko je život čudnovato težak i lak, oni koji su osjetili i stradanje i ljepotu životne jednostavnosti.

programme.desc: The reportage record of the Mosaic Religion show, the author of Radovan Pejcinovic of 1994, brings a review of the religious customs of Bosnian Jews in Sarajevo and Bosnia and Herzegovina, with a special emphasis on the Sabbath holidays, Jom Kippur and the Feast of the Tossi. / Reportažni zapis emisije Mozaik religija, autora Radovana Pejčinovića iz 1994. godine, donosi osvrt na vjerske običaje bosanskih Jevreja u Sarajevu i Bosni i Hercegovini, s posebnim naglaskom na blagdane Šabat, Jom Kipur i blagdan Sjenica.

programme.title: View of the soul / Pogled u dušu
programme.desc: The Museum of the Jews of BiH, located in the old part of Sarajevo, visit numerous tourists every day. The museum, ie the oldest synagogue in Bosnia and Herzegovina, opens the door to the religious rite once a year _ Celebrating Roš Hashan _ Jewish New Year. Reportage "View in the soul" will come to you how to celebrate Roš Hashan, which are the features of a ritual dinner, and a rich Sephardic tradition. Roš Hashana is a "head of the year," a new beginning, which precedes the month of prayer and introspection. "The view in the soul" is a view in the past and a review of the present and guardian of the tradition. / Muzej Jevreja BiH, koji se nalazi u starom dijelu Sarajeva, svakodnevno posjećuju brojni turisti. Muzej, odnosno najstarija sinagoga u Bosni i Hercegovini, jednom godišnje otvara vrata za vjerski obred _ proslavu Roš hašana _ jevrejske Nove godine. Reportaža "Pogled u dušu" dočaraće vam kako se slavi Roš hašana, koje su osobenosti obredne večere, te bogatu sefardsku tradiciju. Roš hašana je "glava godine", novi početak, kojem prethodi mjesec molitve i introspekcija. "Pogled u dušu" je pogled u prošlost i osvrt na sadašnjost i čuvare tradicije.

programme.title: Fundus / Fundus
programme.desc: "Fundus" is a TV story format whose themes are BH. Cultural and historical heritage, unknown stories and details from our heritage, but also a reminder of valuable cultural treasure that preserve museums across the country. The best promotion of the state is through its rich and varied culture. Museum depots keep thousands of valuable cases and exhibits, including numerous world rarities. Collections and collections do not even lag behind the settings in reputable European and world museums. This form of BHRT wants to present them to the general public and remind them of their value. The stories are processed only by basic and most interesting details, with the aim of encouraging viewers to visit museums and institutions in which exhibits are found. In the fundus you will see the interesting facts you haven't known so far, the items you haven't seen before, and it will also present part of the tradition on which there is no information recorded. / "Fundus" je format TV priča čije su teme bh. kulturno-historijsko naslijeđe, nepoznate priče i detalji iz naše baštine, ali i podsjećanje na vrijedno kulturno blago koje čuvaju muzeji širom zemlje. Najbolja promocija države je preko njene bogate i raznovrsne kulture. Muzejski depoi čuvaju hiljade vrijednih predmeta i eksponata, među kojima su brojni svjetski rariteti. Kolekcije i zbirke ni po čemu ne zaostaju za postavkama u uglednim evropskim i svjetskim muzejima. Ovom formom BHRT želi da ih predstavi široj javnosti i podsjeti na njihovu vrijednost. Priče obrađuju samo osnovne i najzanimljivije detalje, s ciljem da potaknu gledatelje da za više informacija posjete muzeje i ustanove u kojima se nalaze eksponati. U Fundusu ćete vidjeti zanimljivosti koje do sada niste znali, predmete koje niste prije vidjeli, a predstaviće i dio tradicije o kojoj nema zabilježenih informacija.

programme.title: Thinking Box / Thinking Box
programme.desc: Turn your brain with the Thinking Box! This show, designed for young people, encourages thinking outside the frame of everyday. Special focus puts on the promotion of young artists and talented girls and young men from all over Bosnia and Herzegovina. / Uključi mozak uz Thinking Box! Ova emisija, osmišljena za mlade, potiče razmišljanje izvan okvira svakodnevice. Poseban fokus stavlja na promociju mladih umjetnika i talentovanih djevojaka i mladića iz svih krajeva Bosne i Hercegovine.

Dio sadržaja emisije su i reportaže o manje poznatim mjestima, ali i priče o lijepim i neobičnim predjelima naše zemlje, te vrijednim i zanimljivim ljudima.

programme.title: Victims of love / Žrtve ljubavi
programme.desc: Guendalina Said to Albert that the next day Lucches would go to Turin and persuade him to follow him to discover his secret and use it against him in the election campaign in which they are on opposite sides. Alberto hesitates, but still listens to his wife's advice, although his path will not introduce the results that Guandalina wanted. Alessandro informs Silvia that Brand's treatment is going in the right direction. On the same evening, Ms. Corradi made a painful decision. She will not participate in a charity dinner organized by her mother -in -law. / Guendalina saopštava Albertu da će narednog dana Lucchesi ići u Torino i nagovara ga da ga slijedi kako bi otkrio njegovu tajnu i iskoristio je protiv njega u izbornoj kampanji u kojoj se nalaze na suprotnim stranama. Alberto oklijeva, no ipak posluša savjet svoje žene, iako njegov put neće iznjedriti rezultate kakve je Guendalina priželjkivala. Alessandro obavještava Silviju da Brandovo liječenje ide u dobrom smjeru. Iste večeri gđa Corradi donese bolnu odluku. Neće sudjelovati u dobrotvornoj večeri koju organizira njena svekrva.

programme.title: Tri mace / Tri mace
programme.desc: Animated series for the youngest about adventures of three fearless kittens who are always ready for new challenges. The cheerful kitten biscuit lives with his big brother Chok and little sister Lola. Their days are filled with fun and socializing with best friends. They like to play, eat sweets, and explore unknown phenomena and objects that surround them. Every day, they embark on a new adventure, and thanks to the wise advice of their caring parents, they solve all obstacles and learn numerous life lessons. / Animirana serija za najmlađe o pustolovinama tri neustrašiva mačića koji su uvijek spremni za nove izazove. Veseli mačić Keksić živi s velikim bratom Čokom i malenom sestrom Lolom. Njihovi dani ispunjeni su zabavom i druženjem s najboljim prijateljima. Vole se igrati, jesti slatkiše, te istraživati nepoznate pojave i predmete koji ih okružuju. Svaki dan upuštaju se u novu pustolovinu, a zahvaljujući mudrim savjetima njihovih brižnih roditelja, rješavaju sve prepreke i uče brojne životne lekcije.

Internacionalni teatarski i filmski festival MESS ujedno je i jedan od vodećih u ovom dijelu Evrope.

programme.title: Civil corner / Građanski ugao
programme.desc: How about the 90s teaching in schools in Montenegro and the region? What is the teaching of history at all and what the chances of teaching are adapted to the standards of developed democratic society, to be deprived of ethnocentricity and encourage a critical way of thinking. Through these topics, through an example of common historical textbooks, Igor Radulović, Professor of history, Professor of History, the Faculty of Philosophy, Ana Radaković, the Faculty of Philosophy, Professor at the Faculty of Philosophy, University of Philosophy Sarajevo. The show will also show a documentary on how these textbooks, translated into 11 languages ​​of the region, arose, as historians from all countries have agreed on the content of books that is the same for all countries, in all languages. / Kako se o 90-im uči u školama u Crnoj Gori i regionu? Kakva je uopšte nastava istorije i kakve su šanse da se ta nastava prilagodi standardima razvijenog demokratskog društva, da bude lišena etnocentričnosti i da podstiče kritički način razmišljanja. Na ove teme, kroz primjer Zajedničkih istorijskih čitanki za 13 zemalja Jugoistočne Evrope govoriće, Igor Radulović, profesor istorije iz Podgorice, Branimr Janković, profesor istorije na Filozofskom fakultetu Sveučilišta u Zagrebu, Ana Radaković, istraživačica na Instituta za savremenu istoriju u Beogradu i Amir Duranović, profesor istorije na Filozofskom fakultetu Univerziteta u Sarajevu. U emisiji će biti prikazan i dokumentarni film o tome kako su te čitanke, prevedene na 11 jezika regiona, nastale, kako su se istoričari iz svih zemalja usaglasili u vezi sa sadržajem knjiga koji je isti za sve zemlje, na svim jezicima.

programme.title: The game of fate / Igra sudbine
programme.desc: Altan finally shows Aziza a diary he found and Aziz realizes that it is a diary of his nana nadide. It will find many answers for their concerns. Just when he thinks that he is on his way to solving all the problems he has found himself, he learns that Feride is in danger. Will Aziz have to choose between the life of his sister Sultan and Feride? / Altan konačno pokazuje Azizu dnevnik koji je pronašao i Aziz shvata da je to dnevnik njegove nane Nadide. U njemu će pronaći mnoge odgovore za svoje nedoumice. Baš kada pomisli da je na putu da riješi sve probleme pred kojima se našao, saznaje da je i Feride u opasnosti. Hoće li Aziz morati birati između života svoje sestre Sultan i Feride?

programme.desc: The animated series follows the exciting adventures of the bold boy Yuye Sakaki, whose father disappeared three years ago. The boy's great dream is to go to his father's footsteps and become a top duelist. After he suddenly discovers a new technique to invoke a monster, that dream slowly begins to be its reality. / Animirana serija prati uzbudljive avanture odvažnog dječaka Yuye Sakakija, čiji je otac nestao prije tri godine. Dječakov veliki san je poći očevim stopama i postati vrhunski duelist. Nakon što nenadano otkrije novu tehniku za prizivanje čudovišta, taj san polako počinje biti njegova stvarnost.

programme.title: The mummies / Mumijevi
programme.desc: They are seemingly ordinary family .. Licensees to Nile horses and live in the Mummy Valley. They bring numerous ordinary and unusual adventures, both in the house and on travel and trips, where they get to know various interesting beings and people. / Oni su naizgled obična porodica.. liče na nilske konje i žive u dolini Mumijeva. Oni donose brojne obične i neobične dogodovštine, kako u kući, tako i na putovanjima i izletima, gdje upoznaju razna interesantna bića i osobe.

programme.title: Slugterra / Slugterra
programme.desc: Fifteen -year -old Eli Shane is in life all usually, except one thing. Comes from the Shane family. Each member of that family traveled to the Underground of Slugterre to protect the special world of Slugs. Now it is a turn on the Elijah, to visit the underground and to protect it from the enemy, whether he is ready or not. Eli is persistent in the intention of becoming a hero, in order to manage to resist the forces of evil. Together with trixie friends, cords and prontine, he must carefully collect and train small animals, different snails, who have the ability to transform into magical monsters. / Petnaestogodišnjem Eliju Shaneu je u životu sve obično, osim jedne stvari. Dolazi iz porodice Shane. Svaki član te porodice putovao je u podzemlje Slugterre, kako bi zaštitio posebni svijet slug-ova. Sada je red na Elija, da posjeti podzemlje i da ga zaštiti od neprijatelja, bio on spreman ili ne. Eli je ustrajan u namjeri da postane heroj, kako bi se uspio oduprijeti silama zla. Zajedno sa prijateljima Trixie, Kordom i Prontom mora pažljivo sakupljati i trenirati male životinje, različite puževe, koji imaju sposobnost transformirati se u magična čudovišta.

Njegova biografija je ujedno i svjedočanstvo o burnom životu Balkana, u kojem, osim ratova, postoje i neke ljepše veze, one koje se osjete kroz muziku i odnos publike prema zajedničkim muzičkim zvijezdama.

programme.title: Victims of love / Žrtve ljubavi
programme.desc: During the walk, Brando realizes that part of the rock will break off exactly on the part of the road where the procession should pass. Going to climb to check it up closely, and that's why Dr. Riga order. The doctor explains to him that his treatment is progressing well, but that it does not mean that he can relax so much. Then he came to visit Silvia unexpectedly. While hugging her, Brando declares her love, but a woman standing opposite him is no longer the same. Carlotta succeeds in provoking a quarrel between Tommas and Maddalene. The young teacher finds a way to redeem their fiancée. Leopoldo Corradi decided to build new roads in Carrari, to facilitate the transport of marble blocks. On Guendalin's incentive, Alberto goes to the digger with the intention of persuading them to vote for him in the coming elections, although they support Annibalea Lucchesia. Guendalina doesn't give up anyway, the Giulian's midwife manages to draw an incredible secret concerning the rival of her husband. Roles: Francesca Valtorta, Giorgio Lupano, Rocco Giusti, Desiree Nofereini, Federica de Benedittis / Tokom šetnje, Brando shvata da će se dio stijene odlomiti baš na dijelu puta kuda treba proći procesija. Krene se penjati kako bi to izbliza provjerio, a zbog toga ga dr. Riga naruži. Doktor mu objasni da njegovo liječenje dobro napreduje, ali da to ne znači da se on može toliko opustiti. Potom mu neočekivano dođe u posjetu Silvia. Dok je grli, Brando joj izjavljuje ljubav, no žena koja stoji nasuprot njemu nije više ona ista. Carlotta uspije izazvati svađu između Tommasa i Maddalene. Mladi učitelj pronalazi način da se iskupi svojoj zaručnici. Leopoldo Corradi je odlučio graditi nove ceste u Carrari, kako bi olakšao transport mramornih blokova. Na Guendalinin poticaj, Alberto odlazi do kopača s namjerom da ih nagovori da glasaju za njega na narednim izborima, iako oni podržavaju Annibalea Lucchesija. Guendalina svejedno ne odustaje, od primalje Giuliane uspije izvući nevjerovatnu tajnu koja se tiče suparnika njenog muža. Uloge: Francesca Valtorta, Giorgio Lupano, Rocco Giusti, Desiree Nofereini, Federica De Benedittis

programme.title: Tri mace / Tri mace
programme.desc: Animated series for the youngest about adventures of three fearless kittens who are always ready for new challenges. The cheerful kitten biscuit lives with his big brother Chok and little sister Lola. Their days are filled with fun and socializing with best friends. They like to play, eat sweets, and explore unknown phenomena and objects that surround them. Every day, they embark on a new adventure, and thanks to the wise advice of their caring parents, they solve all obstacles and learn numerous life lessons. / Animirana serija za najmlađe o pustolovinama tri neustrašiva mačića koji su uvijek spremni za nove izazove. Veseli mačić Keksić živi s velikim bratom Čokom i malenom sestrom Lolom. Njihovi dani ispunjeni su zabavom i druženjem s najboljim prijateljima. Vole se igrati, jesti slatkiše, te istraživati nepoznate pojave i predmete koji ih okružuju. Svaki dan upuštaju se u novu pustolovinu, a zahvaljujući mudrim savjetima njihovih brižnih roditelja, rješavaju sve prepreke i uče brojne životne lekcije.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V / Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: The animated series follows the exciting adventures of the bold boy Yuye Sakaki, whose father disappeared three years ago. The boy's great dream is to go to his father's footsteps and become a top duelist. After he suddenly discovers a new technique to invoke a monster, that dream slowly begins to be its reality. / Animirana serija prati uzbudljive avanture odvažnog dječaka Yuye Sakakija, čiji je otac nestao prije tri godine. Dječakov veliki san je poći očevim stopama i postati vrhunski duelist. Nakon što nenadano otkrije novu tehniku za prizivanje čudovišta, taj san polako počinje biti njegova stvarnost.

programme.title: The mummies / Mumijevi
programme.desc: They are seemingly ordinary family .. Licensees to Nile horses and live in the Mummy Valley. They bring numerous ordinary and unusual adventures, both in the house and on travel and trips, where they get to know various interesting beings and people. / Oni su naizgled obična porodica.. liče na nilske konje i žive u dolini Mumijeva. Oni donose brojne obične i neobične dogodovštine, kako u kući, tako i na putovanjima i izletima, gdje upoznaju razna interesantna bića i osobe.

programme.title: Slugterra / Slugterra
programme.desc: Fifteen -year -old Eli Shane is in life all usually, except one thing. Comes from the Shane family. Each member of that family traveled to the Underground of Slugterre to protect the special world of Slugs. Now it is a turn on the Elijah, to visit the underground and to protect it from the enemy, whether he is ready or not. Eli is persistent in the intention of becoming a hero, in order to manage to resist the forces of evil. Together with trixie friends, cords and print, he must carefully collect and train small animals, different snails, who have the ability to transform into magical monsters. / Petnaestogodišnjem Eliju Shaneu je u životu sve obično, osim jedne stvari. Dolazi iz porodice Shane. Svaki član te porodice putovao je u podzemlje Slugterre, kako bi zaštitio posebni svijet slug-ova. Sada je red na Elija, da posjeti podzemlje i da ga zaštiti od neprijatelja, bio on spreman ili ne. Eli je ustrajan u namjeri da postane heroj, kako bi se uspio oduprijeti silama zla. Zajedno sa prijateljima Trixie, Kordom i Prontom mora pažljivo sakupljati i trenirati male životinje, različite puževe, koji imaju sposobnost transformirati se u magična čudovišta.

programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E39, featured series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Promess owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E39, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.title: Herbs / Lovac na bilje
programme.desc: Plane hunter - (S03, E02, Doc. Series, Croatia, 2021) "Plague Hunter" is a unique adventure documentary series that speaks to Croatian natural wealth and herbs in an educational and attractive way. Mentor Anton Rudan, also better known as an enthusiastic herb hunter, seeks and discovers a wild, autochthonous and alohtono plant at spectacular locations across Croatia. Numerous plant species, as well as all their accompanying and beneficial values ​​in health, in gastronomy, sources of drinking and quality water, climate and landscape diversity, are the basis of each of the 12 episodes. Through the "Rudan" series "Rudan hunter" is also encountered with many challenges and adventurous, extreme situations through which we are introduced to the various ends whose help often reveals different types of plants, referring to the history of a particular site and their relationships with plants and, of course, preserving their natural heritage. In the time of increasing environmental awareness, the theme of the "Hunter on herbs" offers viewers and a kind of invitation and motivation for independent but accessible research the middle. In addition, improving the quality of your own life, the rules of conduct and navigation in nature, as well as actively spending free time with minimal expense, which does not require distant travel, will be additional motivation to viewers of this series, created and realized solely in domestic production. R.: Filip Filkovic ... / Lovac na bilje - (S03, E02, dok. serija, Hrvatska, 2021) "Lovac na bilje" jedinstvena je pustolovna dokumentarna serija koja na edukativan i atraktivan način progovara o hrvatskim prirodnim bogatstvima i bilju. Voditelj Anton Rudan, poznatiji i kao entuzijastični Lovac na bilje, traži i otkriva samoniklo, autohtono i alohtono bilje na spektakularnim lokacijama širom Hrvatske. Mnogobrojne biljne vrste, kao i sve njihove popratne i blagotvorne vrijednosti što u zdravlju, što u gastronomiji, izvori pitke i kvalitetne vode, klimatska i krajobrazna raznolikost, temelj su svake od 12 epizoda.Kroz seriju "Lovac na bilje" Rudan se susreće i s mnogim izazovima te avanturističkim, ekstremnim situacijama putem kojih nas upoznaje s različitim krajevima i mještanima, inače specijaliziranim stručnjacima, uz čiju pomoć nerijetko razotkriva različite vrste bilja, pritom se referirajući na povijest pojedinog lokaliteta te njihovog odnosa s biljkama i, dakako, očuvanjem njihove prirodne baštine.U vrijeme sve veće ekološke osviještenosti, tematika serije "Lovac na bilje" nudi gledateljima i svojevrsnu pozivnicu te motivaciju za samostalno, ali pristupačno istraživanje i uvid u netaknutu prirodu koja se nalazi nadomak urbanih sredina. Uz to, poboljšanje kvalitete vlastitog života, pravila ponašanja i snalaženja u prirodi, kao i aktivno provođenje slobodnog vremena uz minimalan trošak, koje ne iziskuje daleka putovanja, bit će dodatna motivacija gledateljima ove serije, kreirane i realizirane isključivo u domaćoj produkciji. R.: Filip Filković...

programme.title: We were born on Morava / Rodili smo se na Moravi
programme.desc: We were born on Morava - (Educational Program, Croatia, 2018) on the occasion of the 70th anniversary of the beginning of the emigration of Moravian Croats, produced by the emissions of folk and dedicated culture by culture during 2017 and 2018, the documentary by Davor Boric and Ljiljana Sismanovic was created. The film is reminiscent of an almost forgotten and wider Croatian public of the unknown historical fate of the Croatian minority in the Czech Republic and documents their memories and remains of the heritage of Moravian Croats, which they have been trying to record from the 1990s and revitalize. Every first Sunday in September, displaced Moravian Croats, their descendants and their friends Czechs and Germans gather at Kiritof in Jevišovka. They participate in the mass celebration, lay flowers on monuments and graves, and then hang out and remember the last days with a folklore program, eating and drinks. The Association of Citizens of Croatian National in the Czech Republic, led by brother and sister Jan Kopřiva and Lenka Kopřivová, launched in 2010. An extensive documentation project of the fate and the language of Moravian Croats, which made Lenka Kopřivová about 30 conversations with the old Moravian Croats who still speak their dialect and remember old customs, legend and details. A songbook of Moravian Croats and a CD with their songs. The documentary film with the atmosphere of Kiritof in Jevišovki, the fragments of Josef Lawitschke's life stories, Marie Salamon and Ana Luzarov, and the narration of Lenka Kopivova, brings only the preserved folklore treasure - "Croatian wedding", choreography depicting the wedding customs of the Moravian Croats, and today, as well as the National Costumes of Moravian Croats. Czech Society "Palava" from Mikulov. R .: Davor Boric ... / Rodili smo se na Moravi - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2018) U povodu obilježavanja 70. obljetnice od početka iseljavanja moravskih Hrvata u produkciji emisija pučke i predajne kulture PO Kultura tijekom 2017. i 2018. godine nastajao je dokumentarni film autora Davora Borića i Ljiljane Šišmanović. Film podsjeća na gotovo zaboravljenu i široj hrvatskoj javnosti nepoznatu povijesnu sudbinu hrvatske manjine u Češkoj i dokumentira njihova sjećanja i ostatke baštine moravskih Hrvata koju od devedesetih pokušavaju zabilježiti i koliko je moguće, revitalizirati. Svake prve nedjelje u rujnu raseljeni moravski Hrvati, njihovi potomci i njihovi prijatelji Česi i Nijemci okupljaju se na Kiritofu u Jevišovki. Sudjeluju u misnom slavlju, polažu cvijeće na spomenike i grobove, a potom se druže i prisjećaju minulih dana uz folklorni program, jelo i piće. Udruga građana hrvatske narodnosti u Češkoj, koju vode brat i sestra Jan Kopřiva i Lenka Kopřivová, pokrenula je 2010. opsežan dokumentacijski projekt Sudbine i jezik moravskih Hrvata, u sklopu kojeg je Lenka Kopřivová snimila oko 30 razgovora sa starim moravskim Hrvatima koji još govore svoj dijalekt i pamte stare običaje, predaje, legende i detalje iz svakodnevnog života prije 1945. Objavljena je i pjesmarica moravskih Hrvata te CD s njihovim pjesmama. Dokumentarni film uz atmosferu Kiritofa u Jevišovki, fragmente životnih priča Josefa Lawitschke, Marie Šalamonove i Ane Luzarove, te naraciju Lenke Koprivove, donosi i jedino sačuvano folklorno blago - "Hrvatsku svadbu", koreografiju koja prikazuje svadbene običaje moravskih Hrvata, a danas je, kao i narodne nošnje moravskih Hrvata, čuvaju i izvode članovi češkoga društva "Palava" iz Mikulova. R.: Davor Borić...

programme.title: Parenting in the animal world / Roditeljstvo u životinjskom svijetu
programme.desc: Parenthood - (E02, Nature. Film, England, 2025) Parenting in the oceans is a very rare occurrence. Most marine animals completely avoid it and leave it a young man to himself. Those animals that still accept this burden have some of the most amazing strategies in the world. Among the coral reefs, where the space is limited, animals must be creative when finding a home for their young. In Indonesia, the dedicated father of Banga's Cardinal prevails this problem by keeping his younger in his mouth while the extraordinary mother of dolphins in the Red Sea teach the cubs playing on the ridge and to grow, they use reef for autotherapy. In cooler oceans, marine algae serve as excellent nurseries. The master camouflage of the sea dragon in Australia helps one male guard the icr on safe while the extraordinary moist shrimp must carry the cubs among the currents while looking for food. The resourceful vid in Scotland has to find enough fish among the sea grass in order to preserve its three cubs, but for that purpose she has to leave them for more hours, with almost catastrophic consequences. Some marine parents are used by intelligence to adapt. Mothers at whales in Australia learn a flock to hunt blue whales, and this cultural lesson is transmitted through generations and is crucial for their future success. Not far from them, the octopus converts a discarded plastic tube into a home for its eggs, which is tirelessly kept until it is independent. In the South African Republic, the parents of the capsian blune flies hundreds of miles to find food for growth birds. Despite this great parental sacrifice, their pups face the challenges of unprecedented. Their first flight involves avoiding hungry seals of fur who now hunt the pups of the blun for exhausted fish supplies. People play a key role in the survival of parents in the oceans of our planet. R .: Olly Scholey Ul.: Sir David Attenborough (Narrator) ... / Parenthood - (E02, prirod. film, Engleska, 2025) Roditeljstvo u oceanima vrlo je rijetka pojava. Većina morskih životinja potpuno ga izbjegava i prepušta pomladak sebi. One životinje koje ipak prihvate taj teret imaju neke od najnevjerojatnijih strategija na svijetu. Među koraljnim grebenima, gdje je prostor ograničen, životinje moraju biti kreativne pri pronalaženju doma za svoj pomladak. U Indoneziji predani otac bangajskog kardinala prevladava taj problem tako što svoju mlađ čuva u ustima dok izvanredne majke dupina u Crvenom moru uče mladunce igrama na grebenu te da se, rastući, služe grebenom za autoterapiju. U hladnijim oceanima, morske alge služe kao odlični rasadnici. Majstorska kamuflaža morskog zmaja u Australiji pomaže jednom mužjaku da čuva ikru na sigurnom dok izvanredna vlatna kozica mora mladunce nositi među strujama dok traži hranu. Snalažljiva vidra u Škotskoj mora pronaći dovoljno ribe među morskom travom kako bi sačuvala svoja tri mladunca, ali ih u tu svrhu mora ostaviti same više sati, s gotovo katastrofalnim posljedicama. Neki morski roditelji koriste se inteligencijom da bi se prilagodili. Majke kod kitova ubojica u Australiji uče jato da love plavetne kitove, a ta se kulturološka lekcija prenosi kroz naraštaje i ključna je za njihov budući uspjeh. Nedaleko od njih hobotnica pretvara odbačenu plastičnu cijev u dom za svoja jaja, koja neumorno čuva dok se ne osamostale. U Južnoafričkoj Republici roditelji kapske blune prelete stotine milja kako bi pronašli hranu za ptiće koji rastu. Unatoč toj velikoj roditeljskoj požrtvovnosti, njihovi se mladunci suočavaju s izazovima bez presedana. Njihov prvi let uključuje izbjegavanje gladnih tuljana krznaša koji sad love mladunce bluna zbog iscrpljenih zaliha ribe. Ljudi imaju ključnu ulogu u preživljavanju roditelja u oceanima našeg planeta. R.: Olly Scholey Ul.: Sir David Attenborough (Narrator)...

programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E39, featured series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Promess owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E39, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E40, feature series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Promess, owned by the Luján family, cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E40, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.desc: Our small festivities - (E02, Artistic Program, Croatia, 2024) The documentary series brings stories of lesser -known Croatian events that exude local spirit and gather locals, as well as peculiar people from every corner of the country. How to look at the immigrant policy of the European Union and what are the mistakes of integration? Why doesn't it matter that others love her? What is it like to live in the country of others is a question that gives us a reason to talk to Leil Slimani. Kako gleda na imigrantsku politiku Europske unije i koje su greške integracije? Zašto joj nije važno da je drugi vole? programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E40, feature series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Promess, owned by the Luján family, cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E40, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.title: Parenting in the animal world / Roditeljstvo u životinjskom svijetu
programme.desc: Parenthood - (E02, Nature. Film, England, 2025) Parenting in the oceans is a very rare occurrence. Most marine animals completely avoid it and leave it a young man to himself. Those animals that still accept this burden have some of the most amazing strategies in the world. Among the coral reefs, where the space is limited, animals must be creative when finding a home for their young. In Indonesia, the dedicated father of Banga's Cardinal prevails this problem by keeping his younger in his mouth while the extraordinary mother of dolphins in the Red Sea teach the cubs playing on the ridge and to grow, they use reef for autotherapy. In cooler oceans, marine algae serve as excellent nurseries. The master camouflage of the sea dragon in Australia helps one male guard the icr on safe while the extraordinary moist shrimp must carry the cubs among the currents while looking for food. The resourceful vid in Scotland has to find enough fish among the sea grass in order to preserve its three cubs, but for that purpose she has to leave them for more hours, with almost catastrophic consequences. Some marine parents are used by intelligence to adapt. Mothers at whales in Australia learn a flock to hunt blue whales, and this cultural lesson is transmitted through generations and is crucial for their future success. Not far from them, the octopus converts a discarded plastic tube into a home for its eggs, which is tirelessly kept until it is independent. In the South African Republic, the parents of the capsian blune flies hundreds of miles to find food for growth birds. Despite this great parental sacrifice, their pups face the challenges of unprecedented. Their first flight involves avoiding hungry seals of fur who now hunt the pups of the blun for exhausted fish supplies. People play a key role in the survival of parents in the oceans of our planet. R .: Olly Scholey Ul.: Sir David Attenborough (Narrator) ... / Parenthood - (E02, prirod. film, Engleska, 2025) Roditeljstvo u oceanima vrlo je rijetka pojava. Većina morskih životinja potpuno ga izbjegava i prepušta pomladak sebi. One životinje koje ipak prihvate taj teret imaju neke od najnevjerojatnijih strategija na svijetu. Među koraljnim grebenima, gdje je prostor ograničen, životinje moraju biti kreativne pri pronalaženju doma za svoj pomladak. U Indoneziji predani otac bangajskog kardinala prevladava taj problem tako što svoju mlađ čuva u ustima dok izvanredne majke dupina u Crvenom moru uče mladunce igrama na grebenu te da se, rastući, služe grebenom za autoterapiju. U hladnijim oceanima, morske alge služe kao odlični rasadnici. Majstorska kamuflaža morskog zmaja u Australiji pomaže jednom mužjaku da čuva ikru na sigurnom dok izvanredna vlatna kozica mora mladunce nositi među strujama dok traži hranu. Snalažljiva vidra u Škotskoj mora pronaći dovoljno ribe među morskom travom kako bi sačuvala svoja tri mladunca, ali ih u tu svrhu mora ostaviti same više sati, s gotovo katastrofalnim posljedicama. Neki morski roditelji koriste se inteligencijom da bi se prilagodili. Majke kod kitova ubojica u Australiji uče jato da love plavetne kitove, a ta se kulturološka lekcija prenosi kroz naraštaje i ključna je za njihov budući uspjeh. Nedaleko od njih hobotnica pretvara odbačenu plastičnu cijev u dom za svoja jaja, koja neumorno čuva dok se ne osamostale. U Južnoafričkoj Republici roditelji kapske blune prelete stotine milja kako bi pronašli hranu za ptiće koji rastu. Unatoč toj velikoj roditeljskoj požrtvovnosti, njihovi se mladunci suočavaju s izazovima bez presedana. Njihov prvi let uključuje izbjegavanje gladnih tuljana krznaša koji sad love mladunce bluna zbog iscrpljenih zaliha ribe. Ljudi imaju ključnu ulogu u preživljavanju roditelja u oceanima našeg planeta. R.: Olly Scholey Ul.: Sir David Attenborough (Narrator)...

programme.title: On the edge of science / Na rubu znanosti
programme.desc: On the edge of science - (known. Pop. Series, Croatia, 2025) From the beginning of philosophy, a human being asked her questions: to what extent is the consciousness of something unique human? Do other animals have consciousness? Even the simplest? Stones, water, grasses, trees ... Could it all be aware? Such a worldview is called - Panpsihism. Panpsihism is a set of philosophical doctrines that consciousness is not exclusively for the human species, that other living beings, and even inanimate elements, may have subjective perceptions of the world around them. Panpsihistic ideas are not all the same. Some consciousness attribute to insects, plants and even microorganisms, and the most radical Panpsihism defends the idea that the subjective experience is ubiquitous: that it is in all things ... / Na rubu znanosti - (znan. pop. serija, Hrvatska, 2025) Od početka filozofije ljudsko biće postavilo si je pitanja: u kojoj je mjeri svijest nešto jedinstveno ljudsko? Imaju li druge životinje svijest? Čak i najjednostavnije? Kamenje, voda, trave, stabla... bi li sve to moglo imati svijest? Takav pogled na svijet naziva se - panpsihizam. Panpsihizam je skup filozofskih doktrina koje smatraju da svijest nije nešto isključivo za ljudsku vrstu, da i druga živa bića, pa čak i neživi elementi, mogu imati subjektivne percepcije svijeta koji ih okružuje. Panpsihističke ideje nisu sve iste. Neke svijest pripisuju insektima, biljkama, pa čak i mikroorganizmima, a najradikalniji panpsihizam brani ideju da je subjektivno iskustvo sveprisutno: da se ono nalazi u svim stvarima...

programme.title: Iran: Air view / Iran: Pogled iz zraka

The south of Tehran rise the deserts of the Maralingab desert, the door that introduces us to that Iranian desert. On her western edge in the south direction are the cities of Oasa Kashan, Esfahan and Yazd, built in irrigated zones and in important trade and strategic directions. In the southwest, in the province of Fars, Persepolis emerges, a miracle to admire the whole world. R .: Peter Latzko Ul.: Laurent Lucas (Self - Narrator) ... / LIran vu du ciel - (E02, prirod. film, Francuska, 2020) U središtu Irana nalazi se prostrana visoravan s pustinjama i suhim predjelima. Pustinjski krajolici čine gotovo trećinu površine države. To su područja s okrutnom klimom u kojima je čovjek ipak uspio pronaći svoje mjesto prije više tisuća godina. Južno od Teherana izdižu se dine pustinje Maranjab, vrata koja nas uvode u tu iransku pustinju. Na njezinu zapadnom rubu u smjeru juga nalaze se gradovi oaze Kashan, Esfahan i Yazd, izgrađeni u navodnjavanim zonama i na važnim trgovačkim i strateškim pravcima. Na jugozapadu, u provinciji Fars, izranja Perzepolis, čudo kojem se divi cijeli svijet. R.: Peter Latzko Ul.: Laurent Lucas (Self - Narrator)...

programme.title: What is a classic? / Što je klasik?
programme.desc: What is a classic? - (Cult. Magazine, Croatia, 2025) Welcome to the anniversary season of the show seeking the holy grail of the art of words, the show in which the world is not a screen but a text! We are just entering the tenth year of searching to answer the question of what a classic is. From the moment when someone in Mesopotamia on a clay tile engraved the first signs of a king seeking immortality, the world became written. Words became the boundaries of empires, prayers to the gods, calls for the rebellion and the beacons of hope. Stories form civilizations, change history. They change us. Her power is aware of our tonight's guest, Harvard professor Martin Puchner, who claims that she shapes people, history and civilization ... / Što je klasik? - (kult. magazin, Hrvatska, 2025) Dobro došli u obljetničku sezonu emisije koja traži sveti gral umjetnosti riječi, emisije u kojoj svijet nije ekran, nego tekst! Upravo ulazimo u desetu godinu traganja za odgovorom na pitanje što je klasik. Od trenutka kada je netko u Mezopotamiji na glinenu pločicu urezao prve znakove o kralju koji traži besmrtnost, svijet je postao pisan. Riječi su postale granice carstava, molitve bogovima, pozivi na pobunu i svjetionici nade. Priče oblikuju civilizacije, mijenjaju povijest. Mijenjaju nas. Njezine je moći svjestan naš večerašnji gost, harvardski profesor Martin Puchner, koji tvrdi da ona oblikuje ljude, povijest i civilizaciju...

programme.title: In search of actor Negromante - Pero Kvrgic / U potrazi za glumcem Negromantom - Pero Kvrgić
programme.desc: In search of actor Negromante - Pero Kvrgic - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2007) a show recorded on the occasion of the 80th birthday of the great actor Pere Kvrgic (1927 - 2020). This excellent Negromant-Glumac-Carobnjak always poured the theater mirror to the audience, so that she would be reflected in his dramatic characters. Wishing with "light blood and lordship a quiet night and a good day," he always knew how to smiling mockingly, alluding to the time we live in. He was born on March 4, 1927 in Moravica. Of all the drama heroes played by Pero Kvrgic, the role of the sweep in the play "Dundo Maroje", directed by Mladen Škiljan in 1955, has been embodied in it. Pero Kvrgic had a Harlekina costume and a mask with a caricated long nose in the first Pomet scene and thus costly the essential parts of Negromante text. He brought the actors procession to the scene with thin ropes. In this way, a actor, a wizard, a larch and a sage, who will reveal to the audience, united the secret of the right and false people - "praised" to the people and the people "nazbi" in this way. R .: Lawrence Kiiru ... / U potrazi za glumcem Negromantom - Pero Kvrgić - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2007) Emisija snimljena u povodu 80. rođendana velikog glumca Pere Kvrgića (1927. - 2020.). Ovaj vrsni negromant-glumac-čarobnjak uvijek je publici podmetao kazališno zrcalo, kako bi se ona ogledala u njegovim dramskim likovima. Zaželjevši "svijetloj krvi i gospodstvu mirnu noć i dobar dan", uvijek se znao podrugljivo nasmiješiti, aludirajući na vrijeme u kojem živimo. Rođen je 4. ožujka 1927. u Moravicama. Od svih dramskih junaka koje je Pero Kvrgić odigrao ističe se uloga Pometa u predstavi "Dundo Maroje", u režiji Mladena Škiljana 1955. U njoj se Držićev negromant Dugi Nos utjelovio u liku Pometa. Pero Kvrgić je u prvom Pometovom prizoru imao harlekinski kostim i masku s karikiranim dugim nosom i tako kostimiran govorio bitne dijelove Negromantova teksta. Tankim konopcima dovukao je na scenu povorku glumaca. Na taj se način u Negromantu sjedinio glumac, čarobnjak, lakrdijaš i mudrac, koji će publici otkriti tajnu o pravim i lažnim ljudima - o ljudima "nahvao" i ljudima "nazbilj". R.: Lawrence Kiiru...

programme.title: Gorgona / Gorgona
programme.desc: Gorgona - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2012) The name Gorgon as a common denominator of its existence and behavior was taken by a group of like -minded people (D. Bašicevic, M. Horvat, M. Jevšovar, J. Knifer, I. Kozarić, M. Meštrović, R. Putar, Đ. Seder, J. Vanište), thus in Zagreb, from 1959 Croatian art. Common belonging to the spirit of modernism, which defines it recognizing absurdity, gaps and monotony as aesthetic categories, a tendency for nihilism, and a metaphysical irony, which is still, half a century later, attracts numerous fans and researchers. Gorgona marked the Croatian art scene of the second half of the 20th century, and its members made a crucial impact on the development and valorisation of Croatian contemporary art through their artistic activity and placed it in European frameworks. R.: Ana Marija Habjan ... / Gorgona - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2012) Ime Gorgona kao zajednički nazivnik svog postojanja i ponašanja uzela je grupa istomišljenika (D. Bašičević, M. Horvat, M. Jevšovar, J. Knifer, I. Kožarić, M. Meštrović, R. Putar, Đ. Seder, J. Vaništa) stvorivši tako u Zagrebu, od 1959. do 1966., jednu od najneobičnijih pojava u hrvatskoj umjetnosti. Zajednička pripadnost duhu modernizma što ga definira prepoznavanje apsurda, praznine i monotonije kao estetskih kategorija, sklonost nihilizmu te metafizička ironija ono je što i danas, pola stoljeća kasnije, privlači brojne poklonike i istraživače. Gorgona je obilježila hrvatsku likovnu scenu druge polovice 20. stoljeća, a njezini pripadnici svojim su umjetničkim djelovanjem izvršili presudan utjecaj na razvoj i valorizaciju hrvatske suvremene umjetnosti te je smjestili u europske okvire. R.: Ana Marija Habjan...

Od Zavižana prema južnom Velebitu slijedimo od kamena u kamenu, vijugavu Premužićevu stazu. Provlačeći se uskim kanjonima, gustim šumama i zaravnima nabrojit će 57 kilometara. Velebit je sa zaštićena 2274 četvorna kilometra najveće, ali i najvažnije endemsko čvorište flore i kopnene faune u Hrvatskoj. Preko Alančića dolazimo do prijelaza Velikog Alana, razdjelnice i granice sjevernog i srednjeg Velebita. Najdominantnija u srednjem Velebitu, Šatorina s livadnom zaravni dominira nad koritastom mističnom i drevnom Štirovačom i Klepinom dulibom. Ovdje se stoljetne šume smreke prošarane jelama i bukvama rađaju, stare i umiru bez utjecaja čovjeka. Preko Budakova brda dolazimo do 10 kilometara dugih Dabarskih kukova, predvođenih Bačić kukom. Kukove prate duboke koritaste udoline, dabrovi. Kraj Dabarskih kukova i završetak Premužićeve staze dovodi nas do prirodne razdjelnice Baških Oštarija i važne komunikacije između Karlobaga i Gospića. Starom drevnom Terezijanom prelazimo u krševitiji južni Velebit. Vijencem Groba, nazubljenih, kamenih vrhova letimo iznad Visočice, ogledala najvećega ličkoga grada Gospića. Ribničkim vratima i Javornikom dolazimo do drugoga zaštićenog područja, NP Paklenice. Sveto brdo kao mitski čuvar s dva lica dominira nad južnim Velebitom. Orij...

We are just entering the tenth year of searching to answer the question of what a classic is. From the moment when someone in Mesopotamia on a clay tile engraved the first signs of a king seeking immortality, the world became written. Words became the boundaries of empires, prayers to the gods, calls for the rebellion and the beacons of hope. Stories form civilizations, change history. They change us. Her power is aware of our tonight's guest, Harvard professor Martin Puchner, who claims that she shapes people, history and civilization ... / Što je klasik? - (kult. magazin, Hrvatska, 2025) Dobro došli u obljetničku sezonu emisije koja traži sveti gral umjetnosti riječi, emisije u kojoj svijet nije ekran, nego tekst! Od trenutka kada je netko u Mezopotamiji na glinenu pločicu urezao prve znakove o kralju koji traži besmrtnost, svijet je postao pisan. Riječi su postale granice carstava, molitve bogovima, pozivi na pobunu i svjetionici nade. Priče oblikuju civilizacije, mijenjaju povijest. Mijenjaju nas. programme.desc: In search of actor Negromante - Pero Kvrgic - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2007) a show recorded on the occasion of the 80th birthday of the great actor Pere Kvrgic (1927 - 2020). This excellent Negromant-Glumac-Carobnjak always poured the theater mirror to the audience, so that she would be reflected in his dramatic characters. Wishing with "light blood and lordship a quiet night and a good day," he always knew how to smiling mockingly, alluding to the time we live in. He was born on March 4, 1927 in Moravica. Of all the drama heroes played by Pero Kvrgic, the role of the sweep in the play "Dundo Maroje", directed by Mladen Škiljan in 1955, has been embodied in it. Pero Kvrgic had a Harlekina costume and a mask with a caricated long nose in the first Pomet scene and thus costly the essential parts of Negromante text. He brought the actors procession to the scene with thin ropes. In this way, a actor, a wizard, a larch and a sage, who will reveal to the audience, united the secret of the right and false people - "praised" to the people and the people "nazbi" in this way. R .: Lawrence Kiiru ... / U potrazi za glumcem Negromantom - Pero Kvrgić - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2007) Emisija snimljena u povodu 80. rođendana velikog glumca Pere Kvrgića (1927. - 2020.). Ovaj vrsni negromant-glumac-čarobnjak uvijek je publici podmetao kazališno zrcalo, kako bi se ona ogledala u njegovim dramskim likovima. Zaželjevši "svijetloj krvi i gospodstvu mirnu noć i dobar dan", uvijek se znao podrugljivo nasmiješiti, aludirajući na vrijeme u kojem živimo. Rođen je 4. ožujka 1927. u Moravicama. Od svih dramskih junaka koje je Pero Kvrgić odigrao ističe se uloga Pometa u predstavi "Dundo Maroje", u režiji Mladena Škiljana 1955. U njoj se Držićev negromant Dugi Nos utjelovio u liku Pometa. Pero Kvrgić je u prvom Pometovom prizoru imao harlekinski kostim i masku s karikiranim dugim nosom i tako kostimiran govorio bitne dijelove Negromantova teksta. Tankim konopcima dovukao je na scenu povorku glumaca. Na taj se način u Negromantu sjedinio glumac, čarobnjak, lakrdijaš i mudrac, koji će publici otkriti tajnu o pravim i lažnim ljudima - o ljudima "nahvao" i ljudima "nazbilj". R.: Lawrence Kiiru...

programme.title: Ćiribirs / Ćiribirci
programme.desc: Ćiribirje - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2006) In the documentary "Ćiribirje" Tanja Kanceljak we will lead you through perhaps the least known part of Croatia. Cyribrians or Istor -Romania are a small linguistic group living in Istria. In the north, we will meet the Ciribirians in the village of Zejana, while on the southern slopes of Učka they live in Susnjevica and the surrounding villages. The Zupan people say they speak the female, and in Susnjevica they say they speak Vlach. Despite the small differences, we can say that it is one language, Istor -Romanian. But they have a common origin that has not yet been sufficiently explored. The version is many. The most likely one is that they arrived in Istria in the 14th century, fleeing in front of the Turks. Ciriberians were cattlemen and nomads, and over the centuries they merged with the local population. They brought with them a language that, although without a written trace, has remained in everyday use to this day. Interestingly, the speakers of the Istrorumanjski do not feel a minority or Romanian diaspora, declared either Croats or regionally. According to UNESCO data, there are about a thousand Ciribirians in the world today, while only two hundred are left in Croatia. Apart from a few poems and traditions of bell -winning in Žejan, they do not have their own literature and art. They were left only language and they are a great and significant specialty for Istria and Croatia today. In the documentary Fima "Ciriborica", recorded in 2006, a life of people are shown that many in Croatia do not know exist. The team of Croatian Television toured them from oblivion. R .: Tanja Kanceljak ... / Ćiribirci - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2006) U dokumentarnom filmu "Ćiribirci" Tanje Kanceljak provest ćemo vas kroz možda najmanje poznati dio Hrvatske. Ćiribirci ili Istrorumunji mala su jezična skupina koja živi u Istri. Na sjeveru ćemo Ćiribirce susresti u selu Žejane, dok na južnim padinama Učke žive u Šušnjevici i okolnim selima. Žejanci kažu kako govore žejanski, a u Šušnjevici kažu kako govore vlaški. Unatoč malim razlikama, možemo reći kako je to jedan jezik, istrorumunjski. No zajedničko im je porijeklo koje još uvijek nije dovoljno istraženo. Verzija je mnogo. Najvjerojatnija je ona da su u Istru stigli u 14. stoljeću bježeći pred Turcima. Ćiribirci su bili stočari i nomadi, a tijekom stoljeća stopili su se s domaćim stanovništvom. Sa sobom su donijeli jezik koji je, iako bez pisanog traga, i do danas ostao u svakodnevnoj uporabi. Zanimljivo je da se govornici istrorumunjskog ne osjećaju manjinom, ali niti rumunjskom dijasporom, deklariraju se ili kao Hrvati ili regionalno. Prema podacima UNESCO-a, Ćiribiraca u svijetu danas ima oko tisuću, dok ih je u Hrvatskoj ostalo samo dvjestotinjak. Osim nekoliko pjesama i tradicije zvončarstva u Žejanama, oni nemaju svoju književnost i umjetnost. Ostao im je jedino jezik i oni su danas za Istru i Hrvatsku velika i značajna posebnost. U dokumentarnom fimu "Ćiribirci", snimljenom 2006., prikazan je život ljudi za koje mnogi u Hrvatskoj i ne znaju da postoje. Od zaborava ih je istrgnula ekipa Hrvatske televizije. R.: Tanja Kanceljak...
